title: A worker can still embed an exception in an acceptance item's wording
body:
The amendment record covers only notes on the epic (the 8em channel). A worker-proposed acceptance_criteria or description edit on the epic passes the drop rule as long as it keeps every [A<n>] mark, so an exception can be smuggled into an item's own words ("... runs on pi-durable (the PR review is excepted)") without filing a confirmation. Widening AmendmentFields and the filing to the epic's other prose fields would close that channel; it was left out of this tick deliberately, to keep the delivered mechanism the tick's exact shape.
evidence: internal/exec/subprocess/tracker_edits.go DroppedAcceptanceItems (guards dropped items only); internal/runstate/amendments.go AmendmentFields (notes only)
